title: One record store holds decisions, preferences and facts (S13)
body:
Source: Fable architecture decision 2026-11-15, docs/program/plan.md S13 (Sector 4 — Formats and memory (ADR 0017, ADR 0019; item 4)); program t-b160jt0.
Why: ADR 0017, ADR 0019 — moves the north-star items named in the plan sector. Counts toward the slop cut t-jgent6a.
Outcome: schema gains the types and `subject`, `evidence_kind`, `superseded_by`, `review_by`; `.agents/decisions.json` is queryable and never served; `krn decide`, decisions.md and the d-* rows migrate and are deleted; one standards CLI router
Files: see ADR 0017, ADR 0019 Consequences.
Proof: `bin/krn standards query --type decision "auto-merge" --json: >= 1 row`
Predicted: metric durable-stores == 1
After: S12
